import datetime
import unittest
from decimal import Decimal

import stockroom
from tests.support import CATALOG, MOVEMENTS, ORDERS


class ApiTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_exports(self):
        for name in ("parse_catalog", "parse_movements", "parse_orders", "stock_levels",
                     "price_order", "ParseError"):
            self.assertTrue(hasattr(stockroom, name), name)
        self.assertTrue(issubclass(stockroom.ParseError, ValueError))

    def test_parse_error_attributes(self):
        with self.assertRaises(stockroom.ParseError) as cm:
            stockroom.parse_catalog("\n# c\nAB-100 | x | 12.505 | 1\n")
        self.assertIsInstance(cm.exception, ValueError)
        self.assertEqual(cm.exception.line, 3)
        self.assertIn("line 3", str(cm.exception))

    def test_brief_library_example(self):
        catalog = stockroom.parse_catalog(CATALOG)
        moves = stockroom.parse_movements(MOVEMENTS, catalog)
        self.assertEqual(stockroom.stock_levels(catalog, moves), {"AB-100": 17, "CD-205": 40, "EF-310": 0})


class TextHandlingTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_bom_crlf_comments_blank(self):
        text = "﻿# comment\r\n\r\n   \t\n  # indented comment\r\nAB-100|Gnome|1|2\r\n"
        cat = stockroom.parse_catalog(text)
        self.assertEqual(list(cat), ["AB-100"])
        self.assertEqual(cat["AB-100"].reorder, 2)

    def test_line_numbers_count_blank_and_comment_lines(self):
        text = "﻿\n# x\r\n\nAB-100|Gnome|1|2\r\nbad line\n"
        with self.assertRaises(stockroom.ParseError) as cm:
            stockroom.parse_catalog(text)
        self.assertEqual(cm.exception.line, 5)

    def test_lone_cr_does_not_split(self):
        # A lone CR stays inside the line: the tax field becomes "zero\rreduced", a mistake.
        with self.assertRaises(stockroom.ParseError) as cm:
            stockroom.parse_catalog("AB-100|Gnome|1|2|zero\rCD-200|x|1|1\n")
        self.assertEqual(cm.exception.line, 1)

    def test_other_unicode_breaks_do_not_split(self):
        cat = stockroom.parse_catalog("AB-100|Gno me\x0b|1|2\n")
        self.assertEqual(cat["AB-100"].name, "Gno me\x0b")

    def test_movements_and_orders_ignore_comments(self):
        cat = stockroom.parse_catalog(CATALOG)
        moves = stockroom.parse_movements("﻿# x\r\n\r\n" + MOVEMENTS.replace("\n", "\r\n"), cat)
        self.assertEqual(len(moves), 3)
        orders = stockroom.parse_orders("  # x\n\n" + ORDERS, cat)
        self.assertEqual([o.id for o in orders], ["SO-1001", "SO-1002"])


class CatalogTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_example(self):
        cat = stockroom.parse_catalog(CATALOG)
        self.assertEqual(list(cat), ["AB-100", "CD-205", "EF-310"])
        p = cat["CD-205"]
        self.assertEqual((p.sku, p.name, p.reorder, p.tax), ("CD-205", "Seed packet, mix", 40, "reduced"))
        self.assertIsInstance(p.price, Decimal)
        self.assertEqual(p.price, Decimal("1.99"))
        self.assertIsInstance(p.reorder, int)
        self.assertEqual(cat["EF-310"].tax, "standard")

    def test_prices_accepted(self):
        for price, value in (("12", "12"), ("12.5", "12.50"), ("1.99", "1.99"), ("0.01", "0.01")):
            cat = stockroom.parse_catalog("AB-100|x|%s|0\n" % price)
            self.assertEqual(cat["AB-100"].price, Decimal(value))

    def assertBad(self, text, line=1):
        with self.assertRaises(stockroom.ParseError) as cm:
            stockroom.parse_catalog(text)
        self.assertEqual(cm.exception.line, line)

    def test_prices_rejected(self):
        for price in ("12.505", "1,000.00", "-3", "abc", "0", "0.00", "", ".5", "1.", "+1", "١"):
            self.assertBad("AB-100|x|%s|0\n" % price)

    def test_sku_rules(self):
        for sku in ("A-100", "ABCDE-100", "AB-10", "AB-1000", "AB100", "12-100", "ÄB-100", "AB-١٢٣"):
            self.assertBad("%s|x|1|0\n" % sku)
        cat = stockroom.parse_catalog("abcd-001|x|1|0\n")
        self.assertEqual(list(cat), ["ABCD-001"])

    def test_duplicate_sku_any_case(self):
        self.assertBad("AB-100|x|1|0\n\nab-100|y|1|0\n", line=3)

    def test_empty_name(self):
        self.assertBad("AB-100|  |1|0\n")

    def test_reorder(self):
        for reorder in ("-1", "1.5", "", "x"):
            self.assertBad("AB-100|x|1|%s\n" % reorder)
        self.assertEqual(stockroom.parse_catalog("AB-100|x|1|0\n")["AB-100"].reorder, 0)

    def test_field_count(self):
        self.assertBad("AB-100|x|1\n")
        self.assertBad("AB-100|x|1|0|zero|extra\n")

    def test_tax(self):
        cat = stockroom.parse_catalog("AB-100|x|1|0| ZeRo \nCD-100|x|1|0|Reduced\nEF-100|x|1|0|STANDARD\n")
        self.assertEqual([p.tax for p in cat.values()], ["zero", "reduced", "standard"])
        self.assertBad("AB-100|x|1|0|\n")
        self.assertBad("AB-100|x|1|0|vat\n")


class MovementsTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.cat = stockroom.parse_catalog(CATALOG)

    def assertBad(self, text, line=1):
        with self.assertRaises(stockroom.ParseError) as cm:
            stockroom.parse_movements(text, self.cat)
        self.assertEqual(cm.exception.line, line)
        return cm.exception

    def test_example(self):
        moves = stockroom.parse_movements(MOVEMENTS, self.cat)
        m = moves[1]
        self.assertEqual(m.date, datetime.date(2024, 3, 4))
        self.assertEqual((m.sku, m.quantity, m.note), ("AB-100", -3, "order SO-1001"))
        self.assertEqual(moves[2].note, "")
        self.assertEqual(moves[2].quantity, 40)

    def test_note_kept_as_written_trimmed(self):
        moves = stockroom.parse_movements("\t2024-03-01 \t AB-100\t+5   a  b\tc  \t\n", self.cat)
        self.assertEqual(moves[0].note, "a  b\tc")

    def test_bad_fields(self):
        self.assertBad("2024-02-30 AB-100 +1\n")
        self.assertBad("2024-3-01 AB-100 +1\n")
        self.assertBad("2024-03-01 ZZ-999 +1\n")
        self.assertBad("2024-03-01 AB-100 0\n")
        self.assertBad("2024-03-01 AB-100 +0\n")
        self.assertBad("2024-03-01 AB-100 1.5\n")
        self.assertBad("2024-03-01 AB-100 ++1\n")
        self.assertBad("2024-03-01 AB-100\n")

    def test_negative_stock_reported_at_offending_line(self):
        self.assertBad("2024-03-01 AB-100 +2\n2024-03-02 AB-100 -3\n", line=2)

    def test_negative_stock_uses_date_order(self):
        # In file order the shipment comes first, but in date order the delivery precedes it.
        moves = stockroom.parse_movements("2024-03-05 AB-100 -3\n2024-03-01 AB-100 +3\n", self.cat)
        self.assertEqual(len(moves), 2)
        # Out-of-order dates: line 1 is the first (in date order) to go negative.
        self.assertBad("2024-03-02 AB-100 -5\n2024-03-03 AB-100 +10\n2024-03-01 AB-100 +2\n", line=1)

    def test_same_day_keeps_file_order(self):
        self.assertBad("2024-03-01 AB-100 -1\n2024-03-01 AB-100 +1\n", line=1)
        stockroom.parse_movements("2024-03-01 AB-100 +1\n2024-03-01 AB-100 -1\n", self.cat)


class OrdersTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.cat = stockroom.parse_catalog(CATALOG)

    def assertBad(self, text, line=1):
        with self.assertRaises(stockroom.ParseError) as cm:
            stockroom.parse_orders(text, self.cat)
        self.assertEqual(cm.exception.line, line)

    def test_example(self):
        orders = stockroom.parse_orders(ORDERS, self.cat)
        o = orders[0]
        self.assertEqual((o.id, o.date, o.customer), ("SO-1001", datetime.date(2024, 3, 3), "acme"))
        self.assertEqual(o.lines, [("AB-100", 12), ("CD-205", 3)])
        self.assertEqual(orders[1].lines, [("AB-100", 2)])
        self.assertEqual(orders[1].customer, "Bea")

    def test_ids(self):
        orders = stockroom.parse_orders("so-7 2024-01-01 a AB-100*1\nSo-007 2024-01-01 a AB-100*1\n", self.cat)
        self.assertEqual([o.id for o in orders], ["SO-7", "SO-007"])
        self.assertBad("SO-7 2024-01-01 a AB-100*1\nso-7 2024-01-01 a AB-100*1\n", line=2)
        for oid in ("SO-", "SO7", "PO-1", "SO-1a"):
            self.assertBad("%s 2024-01-01 a AB-100*1\n" % oid)

    def test_bad_lines(self):
        for lines in ("AB-100*0", "AB-100*+1", "AB-100*-1", "AB-100", "AB-100*1,", ",AB-100*1",
                      "ZZ-999*1", "AB-100*1,ab-100*2", "AB-100*1;CD-205*1", "AB-100x1"):
            self.assertBad("SO-1 2024-01-01 a %s\n" % lines)

    def test_field_count_and_date(self):
        self.assertBad("SO-1 2024-01-01 two words AB-100*1\n")
        self.assertBad("SO-1 2024-01-01 AB-100*1\n")
        self.assertBad("SO-1 2023-02-29 a AB-100*1\n")
        self.assertBad("SO-1 2024-01-01 a AB-100*1, CD-205*1\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import unittest
from decimal import Decimal
from types import SimpleNamespace

import stockroom
from stockroom.pricing import allocate
from tests.support import CATALOG, ORDERS


def order(*lines):
    return SimpleNamespace(lines=list(lines))


class PriceOrderTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_brief_example(self):
        cat = stockroom.parse_catalog(CATALOG)
        o = stockroom.parse_orders(ORDERS, cat)[0]
        q = stockroom.price_order(o, cat)
        first, second = q.lines
        self.assertEqual((first.sku, first.quantity), ("AB-100", 12))
        self.assertEqual([first.unit, first.gross, first.discount, first.net],
                         [Decimal("12.50"), Decimal("150.00"), Decimal("-7.50"), Decimal("142.50")])
        self.assertEqual([second.unit, second.gross, second.discount, second.net],
                         [Decimal("1.99"), Decimal("5.97"), Decimal("0.00"), Decimal("5.97")])
        self.assertEqual([q.subtotal, q.order_discount, q.tax, q.total],
                         [Decimal("148.47"), Decimal("0.00"), Decimal("28.80"), Decimal("177.27")])

    def test_all_amounts_two_places_and_no_negative_zero(self):
        cat = stockroom.parse_catalog("AB-100|x|3|0\n")
        q = stockroom.price_order(order(("AB-100", 1)), cat)
        for value in (q.subtotal, q.order_discount, q.tax, q.total, q.lines[0].discount, q.lines[0].unit):
            self.assertIsInstance(value, Decimal)
            self.assertEqual(value.as_tuple().exponent, -2)
            self.assertFalse(value.is_signed(), value)

    def test_volume_discount_tiers(self):
        cat = stockroom.parse_catalog("AB-100|x|1|0|zero\n")
        expect = {9: "0.00", 10: "-0.50", 49: "-2.45", 50: "-5.00", 100: "-10.00"}
        for qty, disc in expect.items():
            line = stockroom.price_order(order(("AB-100", qty)), cat).lines[0]
            self.assertEqual(line.discount, Decimal(disc), qty)
            self.assertEqual(line.net, line.gross + line.discount)

    def test_half_up_rounding(self):
        # 10 x 0.15 = 1.50; 5 % = 0.075 -> 0.08 (half up, not banker's 0.08/0.07)
        cat = stockroom.parse_catalog("AB-100|x|0.15|0\nCD-100|x|0.10|0|reduced\nEF-100|x|0.25|0\n")
        line = stockroom.price_order(order(("AB-100", 10)), cat).lines[0]
        self.assertEqual(line.discount, Decimal("-0.08"))
        # reduced tax on 0.10 is 0.005 -> 0.01
        self.assertEqual(stockroom.price_order(order(("CD-100", 1)), cat).tax, Decimal("0.01"))
        # 10 x 0.25 = 2.50; 5 % = 0.125 -> 0.13
        self.assertEqual(stockroom.price_order(order(("EF-100", 10)), cat).lines[0].discount, Decimal("-0.13"))

    def test_order_discount_threshold(self):
        cat = stockroom.parse_catalog("AB-100|x|499.99|0|zero\nCD-100|x|500|0|zero\n")
        self.assertEqual(stockroom.price_order(order(("AB-100", 1)), cat).order_discount, Decimal("0.00"))
        q = stockroom.price_order(order(("CD-100", 1)), cat)
        self.assertEqual(q.order_discount, Decimal("-15.00"))
        self.assertEqual(q.total, Decimal("485.00"))

    def test_order_discount_tie_goes_to_earlier_line(self):
        # Two equal nets of 250.13: discount 15.01 = 1501p, shares 750.5p each.
        # The spare penny goes to line 1 (standard rate): taxable 242.62 -> tax 48.52.
        # Had it gone to line 2 the tax would be 48.53.
        cat = stockroom.parse_catalog("AB-100|x|250.13|0|standard\nCD-100|x|250.13|0|zero\n")
        q = stockroom.price_order(order(("AB-100", 1), ("CD-100", 1)), cat)
        self.assertEqual(q.subtotal, Decimal("500.26"))
        self.assertEqual(q.order_discount, Decimal("-15.01"))
        self.assertEqual(q.tax, Decimal("48.52"))
        self.assertEqual(q.total, Decimal("533.77"))

    def test_per_line_tax_rates(self):
        cat = stockroom.parse_catalog("AB-100|x|100|0\nCD-100|x|100|0|reduced\nEF-100|x|100|0|zero\n")
        q = stockroom.price_order(order(("AB-100", 2), ("CD-100", 2), ("EF-100", 2)), cat)
        # subtotal 600, discount 18 shared 6/6/6; taxable 194 each -> 38.80 + 9.70 + 0
        self.assertEqual(q.order_discount, Decimal("-18.00"))
        self.assertEqual(q.tax, Decimal("48.50"))
        self.assertEqual(q.total, Decimal("630.50"))


class AllocateTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_largest_remainder(self):
        # 1500p over 166.67/166.67/166.66: exact 500.01/500.01/499.98 -> the last line has the biggest loss.
        self.assertEqual(allocate(1500, [16667, 16667, 16666]), [500, 500, 500])

    def test_ties_to_earlier(self):
        self.assertEqual(allocate(1501, [25013, 25013]), [751, 750])
        self.assertEqual(allocate(2, [1, 1, 1]), [1, 1, 0])

    def test_sums_exactly(self):
        shares = allocate(1234, [101, 202, 303, 7])
        self.assertEqual(sum(shares), 1234)
        self.assertEqual(allocate(0, [5, 5]), [0, 0])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

    def test_stock_json(self):
        rc, out, _ = self.run_cli("stock", "--json")
        self.assertEqual(rc, 0)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(out)[0], {"sku": "AB-100", "name": "Garden gnome", "onhand": 17, "status": "ok"})
        self.assertEqual(list(json.loads(out)[0]), ["sku", "name", "onhand", "status"])
        self.assertTrue(out.startswith('[\n  {\n    "sku": "AB-100",'))

    def test_stock_sorted_by_sku_and_unicode(self):
        self.write("catalog.txt", "ZZ-001|Thé vert|1|0\nAA-001|b|1|0\n")
        self.write("movements.txt", "")
        self.assertOk(["stock"], "AA-001 0 out b\nZZ-001 0 out Thé vert\n")
        rc, out, _ = self.run_cli("stock", "--json")
        self.assertIn("Thé vert", out)

    def test_low(self):
        self.assertOk(["low"], "CD-205 40 40 40\nEF-310 0 0 1\n")
        rc, out, _ = self.run_cli("low", "--json")
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(out), [{"sku": "CD-205", "onhand": 40, "reorder": 40, "buy": 40},
                                           {"sku": "EF-310", "onhand": 0, "reorder": 0, "buy": 1}])

    def test_history(self):
        self.write("movements.txt", "2024-03-04 ab-100 -3 order SO-1001\n2024-03-01 AB-100 +20 first delivery\n"
                                    "2024-03-05 AB-100 2\n")
        self.assertOk(["history", "ab-100"],
                      "2024-03-01 +20 20 first delivery\n2024-03-04 -3 17 order SO-1001\n2024-03-05 +2 19\n")
        rc, out, _ = self.run_cli("history", "--json", "AB-100")
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(out)[0], {"date": "2024-03-01", "delta": "+20", "balance": 20,
                                              "note": "first delivery"})
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(out)[2]["note"], "")

    def test_history_unknown_sku(self):
        self.assertFails(["history", "ZZ-999"], 1, "ZZ-999")
        self.assertFails(["history", "nonsense"], 1)

    def test_receive_appends_and_prints(self):
        self.assertOk(["receive", "2024-03-10", "ef-310", "5", "  from supplier  "], "2024-03-10 EF-310 +5 from supplier\n")

class ShelvesTest(CliCase):
    def test_stock_example(self):
        self.assertOk(["stock"], "AB-100 17 ok Garden gnome\nCD-205 40 low Seed packet, mix\nEF-310 0 out Gift voucher\n")

    def test_stock_json(self):
        rc, out, _ = self.run_cli("stock", "--json")
        self.assertEqual(rc, 0)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(out)[0], {"sku": "AB-100", "name": "Garden gnome", "onhand": 17, "status": "ok"})
        self.assertEqual(list(json.loads(out)[0]), ["sku", "name", "onhand", "status"])
        self.assertTrue(out.startswith('[\n  {\n    "sku": "AB-100",'))

    def test_stock_sorted_by_sku_and_unicode(self):
        self.write("catalog.txt", "ZZ-001|Thé vert|1|0\nAA-001|b|1|0\n")
        self.write("movements.txt", "")
        self.assertOk(["stock"], "AA-001 0 out b\nZZ-001 0 out Thé vert\n")
        rc, out, _ = self.run_cli("stock", "--json")
        self.assertIn("Thé vert", out)

    def test_low(self):
        self.assertOk(["low"], "CD-205 40 40 40\nEF-310 0 0 1\n")
        rc, out, _ = self.run_cli("low", "--json")
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(out), [{"sku": "CD-205", "onhand": 40, "reorder": 40, "buy": 40},
                                           {"sku": "EF-310", "onhand": 0, "reorder": 0, "buy": 1}])

    def test_history(self):
        self.write("movements.txt", "2024-03-04 ab-100 -3 order SO-1001\n2024-03-01 AB-100 +20 first delivery\n"
                                    "2024-03-05 AB-100 2\n")
        self.assertOk(["history", "ab-100"],
                      "2024-03-01 +20 20 first delivery\n2024-03-04 -3 17 order SO-1001\n2024-03-05 +2 19\n")
        rc, out, _ = self.run_cli("history", "--json", "AB-100")
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(out)[0], {"date": "2024-03-01", "delta": "+20", "balance": 20,
                                              "note": "first delivery"})
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(out)[2]["note"], "")

    def test_history_unknown_sku(self):
        self.assertFails(["history", "ZZ-999"], 1, "ZZ-999")
        self.assertFails(["history", "nonsense"], 1)

    def test_receive_appends_and_prints(self):
        self.assertOk(["receive", "2024-03-10", "ef-310", "5", "  from supplier  "], "2024-03-10 EF-310 +5 from supplier\n")
        self.assertOk(["ship", "2024-03-11", "EF-310", "2"], "2024-03-11 EF-310 -2\n")
        self.assertEqual(self.read("movements.txt").decode(),
                         self.files["movements.txt"] + "2024-03-10 EF-310 +5 from supplier\n2024-03-11 EF-310 -2\n")
        self.assertOk(["history", "EF-310"], "2024-03-10 +5 5 from supplier\n2024-03-11 -2 3\n")

    def test_receive_creates_file_and_adds_missing_newline(self):
        os.remove(os.path.join(self.dir, "movements.txt"))
        self.assertOk(["receive", "2024-03-10", "AB-100", "5"], "2024-03-10 AB-100 +5\n")
        self.assertEqual(self.read("movements.txt"), b"2024-03-10 AB-100 +5\n")
        self.write("movements.txt", b"2024-03-01 AB-100 +1")
        self.assertOk(["receive", "2024-03-10", "AB-100", "5"], "2024-03-10 AB-100 +5\n")
        self.assertEqual(self.read("movements.txt"), b"2024-03-01 AB-100 +1\n2024-03-10 AB-100 +5\n")

    def test_dash_led_note_is_a_note(self):
        self.assertOk(["receive", "2024-03-10", "AB-100", "5", "--json"], "2024-03-10 AB-100 +5 --json\n")
        self.assertOk(["ship", "2024-03-10", "AB-100", "1", "-x"], "2024-03-10 AB-100 -1 -x\n")

    def test_refusals_leave_file_identical(self):
        self.write("movements.txt", b"2024-03-01 AB-100 +20\r\n2024-03-05 AB-100 -15")
        before = self.read("movements.txt")
        cases = [
            ["ship", "2024-03-02", "ZZ-999", "1"],
            ["ship", "2024-03-02", "AB-100", "-5"],
            ["receive", "2024-03-02", "AB-100", "+5"],
            ["receive", "2024-03-02", "AB-100", "0"],
            ["receive", "2024-03-02", "AB-100", "abc"],
            ["receive", "2024-03-02", "AB-100", "1.5"],
            ["receive", "2024-03-02", "AB-100", "5", "two\nlines"],
            ["receive", "2024-03-02", "AB-100", "5", "cr\rhere"],
            ["ship", "2024-03-10", "AB-100", "6"],  # 5 left -> -1
            ["ship", "2024-03-02", "AB-100", "10"],  # fine on the day, but the later -15 would go negative
            ["ship", "2024-02-01", "AB-100", "1"],  # before any stock
        ]
        for args in cases:
            self.assertFails(args, 1)
            self.assertEqual(self.read("movements.txt"), before, args)

    def test_negative_stock_message(self):
        self.assertFails(["ship", "2024-03-10", "AB-100", "18"], 1, "below zero")


class FileErrorsTest(CliCase):
    def test_catalog_mistake_named_with_line(self):
        self.write("catalog.txt", "# header\n\nAB-100 | x | 12.505 | 1\n")
        self.assertFails(["stock"], 1, "catalog.txt", "line 3")

    def test_movements_mistake(self):
        self.write("movements.txt", "2024-03-01 AB-100 +1\n2024-02-30 AB-100 +1\n")
        self.assertFails(["stock"], 1, "movements.txt", "line 2")
        self.assertFails(["receive", "2024-03-02", "AB-100", "1"], 1, "movements.txt", "line 2")

    def test_negative_stock_in_file(self):
        self.write("movements.txt", "2024-03-05 AB-100 -1\n2024-03-01 AB-100 +5\n2024-03-02 AB-100 -5\n")
        self.assertFails(["stock"], 1, "movements.txt", "line 1")

    def test_orders_mistake(self):
        self.write("orders.txt", "SO-1 2024-01-01 a AB-100*1\n\nso-1 2024-01-02 b AB-100*1\n")
        self.assertFails(["quote", "SO-1"], 1, "orders.txt", "line 3")

        self.write("orders.txt", "garbage\n")
        self.assertOk(["stock"], "AB-100 17 ok Garden gnome\nCD-205 40 low Seed packet, mix\nEF-310 0 out Gift voucher\n")
        self.write("orders.txt", "SO-1001 2024-03-03 acme AB-100*12,CD-205*3\n")

        self.assertOk(["stock"], "AB-100 0 out Garden gnome\nCD-205 0 out Seed packet, mix\nEF-310 0 out Gift voucher\n")
        self.assertOk(["report"], "")
        self.assertOk(["report", "--format", "csv"], "order,date,customer,status,ordered,shipped,quoted,invoiced\n")
        self.assertOk(["report", "--format", "json"], "[]\n")
        self.assertFails(["quote", "SO-1"], 1, "SO-1")

    def test_missing_catalog_exit_2(self):
        os.remove(os.path.join(self.dir, "catalog.txt"))
        for args in (["stock"], ["quote", "SO-1001"], ["report"]):
            self.assertFails(args, 2, "catalog.txt")

    def test_not_utf8_exit_2(self):
        self.write("movements.txt", b"2024-03-01 AB-100 +1 caf\xe9\n")
        self.assertFails(["stock"], 2, "movements.txt")

    def test_missing_dir_exit_2(self):
        self.assertFails(["--dir", os.path.join(self.dir, "nope"), "stock"], 2)

    def test_bom_and_crlf_files(self):
        self.write("catalog.txt", "\ufeffAB-100|Gnome|1|0\r\n")
        self.write("movements.txt", "\ufeff2024-03-01 AB-100 +3\r\n")
        self.assertOk(["stock"], "AB-100 3 ok Gnome\n")


class CommandLineTest(CliCase):
    def test_dir_anywhere(self):
        expected = "AB-100 17 ok Garden gnome\nCD-205 40 low Seed packet, mix\nEF-310 0 out Gift voucher\n"
        cwd = os.path.dirname(self.dir)
        for args in (["--dir", self.dir, "stock"], ["stock", "--dir", self.dir], ["stock", "--dir=" + self.dir]):
            rc, out, err = self.run_cli(*args, cwd=cwd)
            self.assertEqual((rc, out, err), (0, expected, ""))
        rc, out, _ = self.run_cli("receive", "2024-03-10", "--dir", self.dir, "AB-100", "1", cwd=cwd)
        self.assertEqual((rc, out), (0, "2024-03-10 AB-100 +1\n"))

    def test_usage_errors_exit_2(self):
        cases = [
            [],
            ["frobnicate"],
            ["stock", "extra"],
            ["history"],
            ["quote", "SO-1", "SO-2"],
            ["stock", "--js"],          # abbreviations are not accepted
            ["stock", "--jso"],
            ["report", "--json"],
            ["report", "--form", "csv"],
            ["report", "--format"],
            ["report", "--format", "xml"],
            ["report", "--format=yaml"],
            ["stock", "--dir"],
            ["stock", "--di", "."],
            ["receive", "2024-03-01", "AB-100"],
            ["receive", "2024-03-01", "AB-100", "1", "note", "extra"],
            ["receive", "2024-02-30", "AB-100", "1"],
            ["ship", "24-03-01", "AB-100", "1"],
            ["fulfil", "SO-1001"],
            ["fulfil", "SO-1001", "2024-13-01"],
            ["fulfil", "SO-1001", "--dir", "."],
        ]
        for args in cases:
            rc, out, err = self.run_cli(*args)
            self.assertEqual(rc, 2, args)
            self.assertEqual(out, "", args)
            self.assertIn("stockroom: ", err)

    def test_command_line_checked_before_files(self):
        os.remove(os.path.join(self.dir, "catalog.txt"))
        rc, _, err = self.run_cli("receive", "2024-02-30", "AB-100", "1")
        self.assertEqual(rc, 2)
        self.assertIn("date", err)

    def test_broken_pipe_exits_quietly(self):
        lines = "".join("AB-%03d|Product %d|1|0\n" % (i, i) for i in range(1000))
        self.write("catalog.txt", lines)
        self.write("movements.txt", "")
        env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONPATH=SRC)
        proc = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "-m", "stockroom", "stock"], cwd=self.dir, env=env,
                                stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
        proc.stdout.readline()
        proc.stdout.close()
        err = proc.stderr.read()
        proc.stderr.close()
        self.assertEqual(proc.wait(), 0)
        self.assertEqual(err, b"")

    def test_shell_pipe_to_head(self):
        if not os.path.exists("/bin/sh"):
            self.skipTest("no /bin/sh")
        env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONPATH=SRC)
        proc = subprocess.run(["/bin/sh", "-c", '"$0" -m stockroom stock | head -1; exit "${PIPESTATUS:-0}"',
                               sys.executable], cwd=self.dir, env=env, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                              stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
        self.assertEqual(proc.stdout, b"AB-100 17 ok Garden gnome\n")
        self.assertEqual(proc.stderr, b"")

cat > README.md <<'EOF'
# stockroom

A small inventory and order tool for a one-person shop that keeps its data in three plain text
files: `catalog.txt` (what is sold), `movements.txt` (stock in and out) and `orders.txt` (customer
orders). It works both as a Python library (`import stockroom`) and as a `stockroom` command.

Python 3.9 or newer, standard library only.

## Install

    pip install .

## Library

```python
import stockroom

catalog = stockroom.parse_catalog(open("catalog.txt", encoding="utf-8").read())
moves = stockroom.parse_movements(open("movements.txt", encoding="utf-8").read(), catalog)
print(stockroom.stock_levels(catalog, moves))
```

`parse_catalog`, `parse_movements`, `parse_orders`, `stock_levels` and `price_order` are exported,
along with `ParseError` (a `ValueError` whose `.line` is the offending line number).

## Commands

Every command accepts `--dir DIR` anywhere on the line (default: the current folder).

    stockroom stock [--json]
    stockroom low [--json]
    stockroom history SKU [--json]
    stockroom receive DATE SKU QUANTITY [NOTE]
    stockroom ship DATE SKU QUANTITY [NOTE]
    stockroom quote ORDER [--json]
    stockroom fulfil ORDER DATE
    stockroom invoice ORDER [--json]
    stockroom report [--format text|csv|json]

Exit status is 0 on success, 1 for a mistake in a data file or a refused request, and 2 for an
unreadable file, a missing folder or a command-line error.

## Tests

    python -m unittest
EOF

"""In-process tests of the command-line module (the subprocess tests live in test_cli.py)."""

import contextlib
import datetime
import io
import os
import shutil
import tempfile
import unittest
from decimal import Decimal

import stockroom
from stockroom import cli
from stockroom.cli import (
    Data,
    Failure,
    append_lines,
    check_date_arg,
    find_order,
    find_sku,
    is_option,
    money,
    order_status,
    parse_args,
    parse_with,
    quote_output,
    read_text,
    shipped_quantities,
    status_of,
    to_json,
    usage_error,
    with_lines_appended,
    write_stream,
)
from stockroom.models import Movement, Order, Product, Quote, QuoteLine
from stockroom.parsing import counting_order, split_lines
from tests.support import CATALOG, MOVEMENTS, ORDERS


class TempDirCase(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.dir = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="stockroom-inproc-")
        self.addCleanup(shutil.rmtree, self.dir, True)
        for name, text in (("catalog.txt", CATALOG), ("movements.txt", MOVEMENTS), ("orders.txt", ORDERS)):
            with open(os.path.join(self.dir, name), "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as fh:
                fh.write(text)

    def call_main(self, *args):
        out, err = io.StringIO(), io.StringIO()
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(out), contextlib.redirect_stderr(err):
            rc = cli.main(list(args) + ["--dir", self.dir])
        return rc, out.getvalue(), err.getvalue()


class MainTest(TempDirCase):
    def test_main_stock(self):
        rc, out, err = self.call_main("stock")
        self.assertEqual((rc, err), (0, ""))
        self.assertEqual(out.splitlines()[0], "AB-100 17 ok Garden gnome")

    def test_main_errors(self):
        rc, out, err = self.call_main("history", "ZZ-999")
        self.assertEqual((rc, out), (1, ""))
        self.assertTrue(err.startswith("stockroom: unknown SKU"))
        rc, out, err = self.call_main("bogus")
        self.assertEqual((rc, out), (2, ""))

    def test_main_receive_ship_invoice(self):
        rc, out, _ = self.call_main("receive", "2024-03-10", "CD-205", "1", "note")
        self.assertEqual((rc, out), (0, "2024-03-10 CD-205 +1 note\n"))
        rc, out, _ = self.call_main("ship", "2024-03-10", "CD-205", "41")
        self.assertEqual((rc, out), (0, "2024-03-10 CD-205 -41\n"))
        rc, out, _ = self.call_main("invoice", "SO-1001")
        self.assertEqual(rc, 0)
        self.assertTrue(out.startswith("invoice SO-1001 2024-03-03 acme\n"))

    def test_run_rejects_missing_dir(self):
        with self.assertRaises(Failure) as cm:
            cli.run(["stock", "--dir", os.path.join(self.dir, "missing")])
        self.assertEqual(cm.exception.status, 2)


class ArgsTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_parse_args(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_args(["--dir", "x", "history", "AB-100", "--json"]),
                         ("history", ["AB-100"], {"dir": "x", "json": True, "format": "text"}))
        self.assertEqual(parse_args(["--format", "csv", "report"])[2]["format"], "csv")
        self.assertEqual(parse_args(["ship", "2024-01-01", "AB-100", "-5"])[1], ["2024-01-01", "AB-100", "-5"])
        for argv in ([], ["--json"], ["stock", "--js"], ["report", "--format", "x"], ["fulfil", "S", "2024-02-30"]):
            with self.assertRaises(Failure) as cm:
                parse_args(argv)
            self.assertEqual(cm.exception.status, 2, argv)

    def test_small_helpers(self):
        self.assertTrue(is_option("--json"))
        self.assertFalse(is_option("-"))
        self.assertFalse(is_option("AB-100"))
        check_date_arg("2024-02-29")
        with self.assertRaises(Failure):
            check_date_arg("2023-02-29")
        self.assertEqual(usage_error("x").status, 2)


class FilesTest(TempDirCase):
    def test_read_text(self):
        self.assertEqual(read_text(self.dir, "orders.txt", False), ORDERS)
        self.assertEqual(read_text(self.dir, "nothing.txt", False), "")
        with self.assertRaises(Failure) as cm:
            read_text(self.dir, "nothing.txt", True)
        self.assertEqual(cm.exception.status, 2)

    def test_data_load_and_parse_with(self):
        data = Data(self.dir).load(movements=True, orders=True)
        self.assertEqual(len(data.movements), 3)
        self.assertEqual(data.orders[0].id, "SO-1001")
        with self.assertRaises(Failure) as cm:
            parse_with("x.txt", stockroom.parse_catalog, "bad\n")
        self.assertEqual((cm.exception.status, cm.exception.message), (1, "x.txt: line 1: expected 4 or 5 fields separated by '|', found 1"))

    def test_append_lines(self):
        path = os.path.join(self.dir, "movements.txt")
        with open(path, "wb") as fh:
            fh.write(b"2024-03-01 AB-100 +1")
        append_lines(self.dir, ["2024-03-02 AB-100 +2"])
        with open(path, "rb") as fh:
            self.assertEqual(fh.read(), b"2024-03-01 AB-100 +1\n2024-03-02 AB-100 +2\n")
        self.assertEqual(with_lines_appended("a", ["b", "c"]), "a\nb\nc\n")
        self.assertEqual(with_lines_appended("", ["b"]), "b\n")


class OutputHelpersTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_money_and_json(self):
        self.assertEqual(money(Decimal("-0.00")), "0.00")
        self.assertEqual(money(Decimal("-7.5")), "-7.50")
        self.assertEqual(to_json({"a": "é"}), '{\n  "a": "é"\n}\n')

    def test_status_of(self):
        self.assertEqual([status_of(0, 5), status_of(5, 5), status_of(6, 5), status_of(1, 0)], ["out", "low", "ok", "ok"])

    def test_lookups(self):
        cat = stockroom.parse_catalog(CATALOG)
        self.assertEqual(find_sku(cat, "cd-205"), "CD-205")
        with self.assertRaises(Failure):
            find_sku(cat, "ZZ-000")
        orders = stockroom.parse_orders(ORDERS, cat)
        self.assertEqual(find_order(orders, "so-1002").customer, "Bea")
        with self.assertRaises(Failure):
            find_order(orders, "SO-1")

    def test_shipped_and_status(self):
        order = Order(id="SO-1", date=datetime.date(2024, 1, 1), customer="a", lines=[("AB-100", 3), ("CD-205", 2)])
        moves = [Movement(datetime.date(2024, 1, 1), "AB-100", 10), Movement(datetime.date(2024, 1, 2), "AB-100", -5, "order SO-1")]
        shipped = shipped_quantities(order, moves)

Implements PRD #1 (issue #2): the `stockroom` package and `stockroom` command, standard library only, Python 3.9+.

## What is in it

- `pyproject.toml` (setuptools, no dependencies, `stockroom = "stockroom.cli:main"`), package under `src/stockroom/`, `python -m stockroom` works.
- `parsing.py`: `parse_catalog`, `parse_movements`, `parse_orders`, `stock_levels`, `ParseError` (a `ValueError` with `.line`). BOM dropped, lines split only at LF/CRLF, blank and `#` lines skipped, physical line numbers. `parse_movements` reports the first line, in date order (stable within a day), that takes stock below zero.
- `pricing.py`: `price_order` following steps 1-6 with `ROUND_HALF_UP`, largest-remainder sharing of the order discount (ties to the earlier line), per-line tax, all amounts as 2-place `Decimal`s, discounts never `-0.00`.
- `cli.py`: hand-written argument handling (`--dir` anywhere, options in full only, `receive`/`ship`/`fulfil` take every other argument as typed), `stock`, `low`, `history`, `receive`, `ship`, `quote`, `fulfil`, `invoice`, `report`, with the brief's exit codes; output is built in memory so errors leave stdout empty; a broken pipe exits 0 quietly.
- `tests/`: 94 `unittest` tests covering the field rules, text handling, the brief's `stock` and `quote` examples verbatim, rounding, discount allocation, fulfil against later movements, invoice/report after partial shipment, byte-identical files after refusals, exit-2 cases and the broken pipe.

## Verification

- `python -m unittest`: 94 tests pass on Python 3.13 and 3.9.
- `pip install .` into a fresh Python 3.9 virtualenv gives a working `stockroom` command and `import stockroom`.
- rtdd Round 1 green, Round 2 empty. The only remaining `untested` entries are module-level nodes and non-code files: the CLI is mostly exercised through `subprocess`, which rtdd's static graph cannot follow.

- `receive`/`ship` trim spaces and tabs around the note before writing it, so the printed line matches what `history` shows when the file is read back. The brief already trims notes when it reads them, so this doesn't conflict with it.
- When a `receive`/`ship` would make any later movement go negative, it is refused with exit 1 and the message names the movement and where the stock would go below zero.

No conflicts between the original request, the PRD and the issue.

Closes #2

content.text:
I built the `stockroom` package and command, and PR #3 is squash-merged into `main`. The PR says `Closes #2`, so the merge closes the issue.

- **Library:** you can import `parse_catalog`, `parse_movements`, `parse_orders`, `stock_levels`, `price_order` and `ParseError` from `stockroom`. Every rule the brief gives for the three files is checked, and each mistake is reported with its line number.
- **Command:** `stock`, `low`, `history`, `receive`, `ship`, `quote`, `fulfil`, `invoice` and `report`, with the exit codes, `--dir` handling and output formats the brief asks for. The brief's `stock` and `quote` examples come out exactly as written.
- **Tests:** 94 `unittest` tests, all passing on Python 3.13 and 3.9. Running `pip install .` into a fresh Python 3.9 environment gave a working `stockroom` command and `import stockroom`.

**What counted as the merge check:** the repo has no CI script, and `main` hadn't moved since I branched, so rtdd's two test rounds were the check. Round 1 (the whole suite) passed and Round 2 selected nothing. rtdd still lists a few items as untested, but they are only module-level code (imports and constants) and non-code files. It can't trace tests that run the command in a separate process, so I added direct tests for the rest. I also checked that the broken-pipe test fails when its handler is removed.

**One judgement call, noted in the PR:** `receive` and `ship` trim spaces and tabs from both ends of the note before writing it. Notes are trimmed when the file is read anyway, so the printed line matches what `history` shows later. I found no conflicts between the original request, the PRD and the issue.
